cedar2.note: CEDAR2 significant-eQTL tables were queried. The full 1.5 GB macrophage nominal file was not exhaustively parsed because the significant macrophage node contained no PRKCB eQTL row.

clinical_trials.sotrastaurin_efficacy_signal: Posterior probability of any clinical-remission improvement was 95.5%, but the 95% credibility interval crossed zero and the probability of a >=20% difference was only 14.2%.
clinical_trials.sotrastaurin_safety: Higher any-AE and gastrointestinal/renal AE frequencies than placebo; serious AE frequency was not higher in the small trial.
clinical_trials.treatment_recommendation: Not supported: small early-terminated phase 2b study, no primary publication, no confirmatory trial and no target-selective drug.

mpra_design_status: rs7404003 is already included in the prespecified top-three lentiMPRA package with three 251-bp windows, both alleles, six donors and resting/LPS/IFN-gamma/IL-23 conditions. No result exists.
crispri_status: Gene-level PRKCB CRISPRi remains complementary, not allele-specific. Four independent guides plus safe-harbor and non-targeting controls should measure PRKCB, TNF, IL23A, CXCL10 and NF-kB readouts.
treatment_recommendation: No clinical treatment recommendation is supported. Sotrastaurin has a small early-terminated phase 2b UC study with an uncertain efficacy interval and no target-selective pharmacology.
